paragraphs: (Zevina, Ezra 10:43.) Rav Yehudah bar Zevina: Sotah 12a.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Miqra according to the Masorah Ezra 10:43 verse contains Zevina; the separate Davidson Sotah 12a paragraph explicitly names Rav Yehudah bar Zevina. The parenthetical biblical pointer is retained without connecting its person to the later patronymic or importing any other biblical names.
